liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Valley Road** (2 reviews): Listener highlights the performance of this track, noting the band played it well; Listener notes this was the first time the band played the song [16][26]

## Setlist highlights

- **Valley Road**: rare: 7 archived performances [28]

## The recordings

- **gd90-10-22.sbd.gardner.8722.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 147 min; rated 3.89/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording contains significant audience noise despite being labeled as a soundboard [25]
- **gd90-10-22.dsbd.hinko.22315.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 149 min; rated 2.4/5 by 5 [6]. Said about its sound: Vocalist is slightly high in the mix initially but balances out later; Listener describes the opening song as sounding awful and advises skipping it; Listener praises the clarity and headroom of this specific recording source [18][26]
- **gd1990-10-22.165843.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1644**: soundboard; 18 songs; 149 min [7]
- **gd1990-10-22.nak300.houck-wright.gmb.90745.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 146 min [9]

## Around the show

- Listener recalls Jerry singing this song and the venue as memorable aspects [16]
- Dutch band played on a bus outside, and audience formed a drum circle [19]
- Attendees drank beer and smoked in the car park before the concert [21]
- Listener suggests the show illustrates Bruce's frustration with the band's song execution [24]
- Listener compares the sound of this song to a later 1990 performance [17]
- Listener finds this show tighter and more energetic than the Berlin run [18]
- Listener felt this show was a letdown compared to the recent Berlin dates [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd90-10-22.sbd.gardner.8722.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>C>DAT>CDR [1]. Also: Seeded by Tony Gardner, the audio was transferred from SBD to DAT to CD [1]
- **gd90-10-22.dsbd.hinko.22315.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]
- **gd1990-10-22.165843.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  August 11, 2023; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Maxell MX100/TDK SA-X100) [7]
- **gd1990-10-22.nak300.houck-wright.gmb.90745.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alf Houck and Robert Wright; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Audience Master Cassette Nakamichi 300�s Cardioids > Marantz PMD-430 > Dolby B [9]. Also: A patch source was used to cover tape flips after Desolation Row [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.freies-wild.online: [Grateful Dead – freies wild online](https://www.freies-wild.online/grateful-dead-list/) [29]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1990-10-22 Mon Festhalle, Frankfurt, Germany](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1316343237031/grateful-dead-1990-10-22-mon-festhalle) [30]
- Poster by original-concert-posters.com: [26 | February | 2025 | Original Concert Posters](https://original-concert-posters.com/2025/02/26/) [31]
